text: Explicit reprojection + the camera transform as network input (net corrects, doesn't relearn the warp)
description: We do the reprojection (2×2 tent splat), which saves the net work. The net still gets the camera delta (rotation, translation, zoom) as a global conditioning vector (FiLM) plus the per-pixel reprojection offset field. Inputs per eye: the previous frame (unwarped) + the reprojected frame + certainty + depth. Cross-eye reprojection: both previous eyes are splatted into each current eye, so stereo fills many disocclusions for free.
